details: This package is a WhatsApp Web multi-device library (a fork of Baileys) that silently enrols the connecting account into a specific WhatsApp newsletter channel. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket registers a connection.update handler that, whenever the socket reaches connection === "open" — and again on every reconnect — sends a hardcoded newsletter FOLLOW query for the channel newsletter_id 120363417337256584@newsletter through the WhatsApp MEX endpoint (QueryIds.FOLLOW / XWAPaths.xwa2_newsletter_join_v2). The effect is that any application using this library subscribes its WhatsApp account to that channel without the end user choosing to; the behaviour is not opt-in, has no configuration flag, and is mentioned only in a single line deep in the README. It performs no other hidden network activity: the only destinations referenced in the shipped code are WhatsApp's own endpoints, and there is no collection or transmission of credentials, session files, tokens or environment data. The package ships a preinstall hook, engine-requirements.js, that only checks for Node.js 20 or newer. Note also that the package reuses the canonical "baileys" basename under an unofficial scope rather than the upstream @whiskeysockets scope.
